title: Clip names when several people clip the same sample
description: Scores name a clip by sample path + name. Two owners can now each have a clip called loop-1 on one sample (editing someone else's clip saves your copy under the same name). Decide: owner-qualified names, auto-rename copies, or ids in scores.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Plan: clip names unique per sample. Copy of someone else's clip is named <name>-<handle> (loop-1-ryan). validateClips only rejects your own new/changed rows; markup skips taken names; compiler reports ambiguous non-retired duplicates.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Deployed (Amplify job 48, commit 48abb3a); prod smoke passed.
